CONTACT

HELLO I'M V

I'm V, a french creative / front end developer.

I love to experiment, iterate and build premium experiences.

After studying in Paris and working in Shanghai, I'm currently a front end Monk at Media Monks, in the lovely city of Amsterdam.

You can find me on Twitter (@__vaalentin), Github (vaalentin). And if you fancy it, even send me an email (valentin.marmonier@gmail.com)

ABOUT THIS

This is not really a portfolio, but my attempt at learning WebGL.
And it was quite an enjoyable experience thanks to the amazing Three.js and GSAP
